server.name: io.github.stonematt/mcp-obsidian-cli
server.description: Save chat notes from Claude Desktop to your vault — MCP on Obsidian CLI. Keep what matters.

environmentVariables.description: Target vault name. If unset or unknown, the server prompts the caller on first tool use, listing the vaults Obsidian knows about.
environmentVariables.name: OBSIDIAN_VAULT

environmentVariables.description: Path to the obsidian-cli binary. Auto-discovered on macOS; set explicitly on Linux/Windows or if the binary is non-standard.
environmentVariables.name: OBSIDIAN_CLI_PATH

environmentVariables.description: Per-command timeout in milliseconds.
environmentVariables.name: OBSIDIAN_TIMEOUT_MS
